title: Sunrise/gm deltaB mint is NOT flash-loan manipulable (cumulative-pump TWAP); inverted-TWAP oracle bug (DT-006/OR-001) does not reach the live mint path

location.code_snippet: ICumulativePump(pumps[0].target).readTwaReserves(well, lastSnapshot, uint40(s.sys.season.timestamp), pumps[0].data) // season-length TWAP, not spot

description: Documenting the negative result demanded by the attack-surface hypotheses (SeasonFacet sunrise/gm -> deltaB mint, CC-005/CH-005). The permissionless season advance SeasonFacet sunrise()/gm() -> Oracle.stepOracle() -> LibWellMinting.capture(well) -> twaDeltaB() reads ICumulativePump.readTwaReserves(well, lastSnapshot, s.sys.season.timestamp, ...): a time-weighted average of cumulative reserves accumulated since the previous season's snapshot, NOT instantaneous reserves. A flash loan that skews the well within the calling block contributes negligibly to a season-length TWAP, so the minted deltaB (and the caller's reward Beans) cannot be materially inflated by a single-tx reserve skew. The minting oracle also self-disables (returns deltaB 0) when twaReserves[beanIndex] < WELL_MINIMUM_BEAN_BALANCE or the USD oracle fails. Separately, the deep-trace DT-006 / oracle OR-001 inverted TWAP/spot ternary in LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice is on a Chainlink (not AMM) source, so its return is not flash-loan manipulable, AND the live BEAN:WETH / BEAN:WSTETH wells obtain their USD price via LibEthUsdOracle / LibWstethUsdOracle, not via the inverted getTokenPrice branch — so it does not feed the live sunrise/deltaB mint. Conclusion: the naive 'flash-loan skew well -> over-mint Beans in sunrise' attack is defended by the cumulative-pump TWAP and is reported here only to close the hypothesis. The residual manipulable surface is the convert-PENALTY spot path (FL-001), not the mint.
impact: None (defended path). Recorded so triage does not re-open the sunrise mint flash-loan hypothesis without new evidence. The only conditions that could revive it: a well wired to a pump whose readTwaReserves can be saturated within one block (very short effective window), or a future well whitelisted with a Chainlink-impl USD oracle that routes through the inverted getTokenPrice (OR-001) on a lookback>0 minting request.

ite.intent: Confirm whether sunrise/gm deltaB minting consumes manipulable spot reserves.
ite.technique: Trace the mint path's reserve source: it is the cumulative pump TWAP, not spot.
